Colfosceril palmitate (Exosurf Neonatal) is a synthetic, protein-free pulmonary surfactant of dipalmitoylphosphatidylcholine (DPPC) combined with cetyl alcohol and tyloxapol.

It is instilled intratracheally through the endotracheal tube to prevent and treat respiratory distress syndrome (RDS, hyaline membrane disease) in premature infants by replacing deficient endogenous surfactant, lowering alveolar surface tension, and improving lung compliance and oxygenation.

It is administered only by clinicians trained in neonatal intubation and ventilation, with continuous monitoring; key acute hazards include pulmonary hemorrhage, apnea, mucus plugging of the endotracheal tube, and transient bradycardia/desaturation during dosing.
